entries.title: France downs Morocco 2-0 to advance to the World Cup semifinal
entries.snippet: Morocco was no match for France, which lost 2-0. The French, one of the pre-tournament favorites, move on to the World Cup semifinals against either Spain or Belgium.

entries.title: Smithsonian chief emphasizes 'accuracy and integrity' after White House report
entries.snippet: The memo from the Smithsonian's secretary, Lonnie Bunch, responded to a White House report that calls the National Museum of American History driven by "a radical, activist ideology."

entries.title: How to deal with seesawing gas prices
entries.snippet: Gas prices have fluctuated since the U.S. and Israel launched a war on Iran, which disrupted shipping through the Strait of Hormuz and left consumers unsure of what they'll pay at the pump.

entries.title: EPA proposes weakening heavy-duty truck pollution rules
entries.snippet: The Trump EPA calls Biden-era rules for cutting pollution from heavy trucks "unworkable." The proposed changes have been celebrated by trucking groups and denounced by environmental groups.

entries.title: A new kind of robot swims the seas and soars the skies
entries.snippet: Inspired by diving birds, roboticists built the lightweight machines to move from water to air. The design may one day lead to robots that can monitor and sample the coastal ocean.

entries.title: Vermont is creating a statewide trail, and making sure it's accessible to all
entries.snippet: Mountain bike enthusiasts have been working for years on an ambitious 485-mile, multi-use trail called The Velomont that will span the length of the state. They're making sure it's friendly for people with disabilities, particularly cyclists.

entries.title: Class action suit against AI makers over deepfake child sexual abuse material expands
entries.snippet: New plaintiffs in a lawsuit against Elon Musk's SpaceXAI and Stability AI say the companies' AI tools were used to make sexually explicit images of them as children.

entries.title: 'Solo agers' are a growing group. Changes that would help them could help everyone
entries.snippet: Many older adults navigate aging on their own — without children or a spouse. An expert says this is "a reality to be supported" rather than a crisis to be solved.

entries.title: Former Olympian pleads not guilty in reflecting pool vandalism charge

entries.title: How to protect your pets from the New World screwworm fly

entries.snippet: Migrants deported from the U.S. and detained in a hotel in Equatorial Guinea say that authorities there also have used the facility to quarantine at least one suspected Ebola patient, deportees and lawyers representing them said Thursday.

entries.title: 8 men indicted on conspiracy charges over planned attack on White House UFC event
entries.snippet: Eight men were indicted on murder and terrorism conspiracy charges Thursday for their alleged roles in a thwarted drone and sniper attack on the UFC cage-fighting show staged at the White House in June.

entries.title: Wally Funk, aviation pioneer who was oldest woman to travel into space, dies at 87
entries.snippet: Funk was one of 13 female pilots who went through the same tests as NASA's all-male astronaut corps in the early 1960s but never made it into space. In 2021, she got her chance aboard Amazon founder Jeff Bezos' Blue Origin rocket.

entries.title: Judge dismisses suit challenging Sen. Tuberville's eligibility to run for Alabama governor
entries.snippet: A judge on Thursday dismissed a lawsuit alleging U.S. Sen. Tommy Tuberville does not meet the residency requirement to run for governor of Alabama.

entries.title: WATCH: White House columns appear to be Trump's latest project
entries.snippet: Crews have draped tarps over the towering stone columns on the north side of the White House, where work is underway to scrape away decades of paint.

entries.title: Mexico to seek criminal charges over deaths linked to ICE after fatal shooting of Houston man
entries.snippet: Mexican Foreign Minister Roberto Velasco's announcement Thursday morning further escalated tensions with the United States, as Mexico's government has sharply criticized the treatment of its citizens under U.S. President Donald Trump's push to increase deportations.

entries.title: South Florida's Palm Beach airport renamed President Donald J. Trump International

entries.snippet: The digital euro has been touted as the EU's best chance at breaking its dependence on US payment systems like Visa and Mastercard, as well as Apple Pay and Google Pay.

entries.snippet: Ukraine's prosecutor general proposed forming a joint investigative team with Germany. Berlin has indicted a former Ukrainian soldier over the blasts and says he was working on behalf of Ukrainian entities.

entries.title: Abbas sets Palestinian legislative elections for November
entries.snippet: The Palestinian Authority has announced it will soon hold its first elections in twenty years. However, questions remain about whether it has the means and legitimacy to do so.

entries.title: South Africa: Driven home by anti-migrant protests

entries.title: Violence on trains in Germany is on the rise
entries.snippet: The verdict in the trial over the killing of a train conductor highlights growing aggression toward railway employees in Germany. What is causing it — and what can be done about it?

entries.title: How do Germans cope with having Nazi grandparents?
entries.snippet: Since millions of NSDAP membership cards have been made available online, many Germans have been surprised to discover that their ancestors weren't always as innocent as family stories had led them to believe.

entries.title: Syria regains voting rights at world chemical weapons watchdog
entries.snippet: The Organization for the Prohibition of Chemical Weapons (OPCW) cited a "change in circumstances" as the reason behind its decision. Syria had joined the watchdog in 2013, only to be stripped of its rights in 2021.

entries.title: Congo: UN laments uptick in fighting in South Kivu
entries.snippet: The UN human rights chief has called for an immediate halt to fighting in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo. This follows intensified clashses between the army and the Rwanda-backed M23 militia in South Kivu.

entries.title: China: Dozens killed in shoe factory fire

entries.title: Iran war: Trump calls second set of US strikes 'retribution'
entries.snippet: The US launched fresh strikes on Iran overnight, the second wave of attacks in 24 hours after President Trump declared a ceasefire to be over. Meanwhile, Iran entombed slain leader Khamenei. DW has more.

entries.title: Iran after Khamenei: A new order takes shape
entries.snippet: Mojtaba Khamenei, Iran's new supreme leader, has inherited a political system that his father spent decades building and shaping in his own image.

entries.title: Germany news: Man jailed over killing of train conductor
entries.snippet: A verdict has been delivered in a trial that drew national attention and raised concern about train staff safety. Meanwhile, VW bosses are eyeing huge restructuring, with unions vowing to fight any closures. DW has more.

entries.title: US midterms: Democrat exits key Senate race after rape claim
entries.snippet: Democrat Graham Platner, an oysterman running for the US Senate in Maine, suspended his campaign after he was accused of sexual assault. The announcement throws a closely watched 2026 midterms race into uncertainty.

entries.title: Merz: Germany agreed to buy Tomahawk missiles at NATO summit
entries.snippet: Chancellor Friedrich Merz has informed the Bundestag parliament of a deal to buy US Tomahawk cruise missiles and station them in Germany. He said this closed a "important strategic ‌gap ​in our defense."

entries.title: Bonnie Tyler, singer of 'Total Eclipse of the Heart,' dies at 75
entries.snippet: The Welsh singer was best known for the 1980s rock opera hit, along with other songs, including "It's a Heartache."

entries.title: Are German companies leaving the country?
entries.snippet: Should I stay or should I go? Given Germany's high cost and sluggish growth, some business leaders are mulling relocating, or at least investing abroad. DW has a look at the numbers.

entries.title: Germany: June heat wave linked to 5,000 excess deaths
entries.snippet: Several other European Union countries reported thousands of additional deaths as June 2026 officially became the hottest on record for bloc.

entries.title: Is the Strait of Hormuz still Iran's trump card?
